sentences.l2: 近年来，线上问诊与送药上门逐渐融入人们的日常生活。
sentences.l1: In recent years, online consultations and home delivery of medicine have gradually blended into people's daily lives.

sentences.l2: 对于慢性病患者而言，往返医院排队挂号、候诊取药的漫长过程本身就是一种消耗；如今只需打开手机，选择一家合规的互联网医院，与医生视频交流、上传检查报告，便能在短时间内获得诊断意见。
sentences.l1: For patients with chronic illness, the long process of going back and forth to the hospital, queuing to register and waiting to be seen and collect medicine is itself a drain; now you only need to open your phone, choose a compliant internet hospital, talk with a doctor by video and upload examination reports, and you can obtain a diagnostic opinion in a short time.

sentences.l2: 医生开具电子处方后，药品由合作的药房配送到家，部分费用还可通过医保在线结算，患者的经济负担随之减轻。
sentences.l1: After the doctor issues an electronic prescription, the medicine is delivered to your home by a partner pharmacy, and part of the cost can also be settled online through medical insurance, so the patient's financial burden is reduced accordingly.

sentences.l2: 这种模式的兴起，折射出医疗资源分布不均的深层矛盾：优质医师集中于大城市，而偏远地区的居民往往求医无门。
sentences.l1: The rise of this model reflects the deep-seated contradiction of the uneven distribution of medical resources: high-quality doctors are concentrated in big cities, while residents of remote areas often have nowhere to turn for treatment.

sentences.l2: 技术并未消除这一鸿沟，却为其提供了一条可跨越的路径。
sentences.l1: Technology has not eliminated this gap, but has provided a path across it.

sentences.l2: 当然，线上问诊终究有其边界——它擅长处理常见病、复诊开药与健康管理，却无法替代面对面的触诊与急救。
sentences.l1: Of course, online consultation has its limits after all: it is good at handling common illnesses, follow-up prescriptions and health management, but cannot replace face-to-face palpation and emergency treatment.

sentences.l2: 理性地看待它的便利与局限，或许才是数字医疗时代最应有的姿态。
sentences.l1: Looking rationally at its convenience and its limitations may be the most fitting attitude in the age of digital healthcare.
